IssuanceTypeRule.definition: Issuance type must be for either 'UndertakingIssuedViaAdvisingParty' (ISAD) or 'UndertakingIsuuedViaConfirmingParty' (ISCO).

RequestedLocalUndertakingRule.definition: Requested local undertaking must not be present.
